items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: that’s how I got to see Nat Cole with my parents. They took me to see him at the Flamingo.

ctx.x: He had the little Italian mouse, you see how? Yeah, who could forget this. Senor Wences — a different guy, but he had yeah this thing. Boy that left an impact. And my parents took — they were very interested in Las Vegas, hearing about it, all, so many of these performers on television and on the talk shows Johnny Carson was our only talk show host at that time. We finally got cable TV from Duluth, Minnesota and were able to see Johnny Carson. And then, you know, Las Vegas, everybody seemed to be talking about it…

went to but dinner shows, they had something they called the dinner show at that time and if there was anything risque about you know this show, a dinner show would be much milder in comparison. Kids were allowed to go because they served dinner — a technicality — and that’s how I got to see Nat Cole with my parents. They took me to see him at the Flamingo. I’ll never forget it.

items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: that’s how I got to see Nat Cole with my parents. They took me to see him at the Flamingo.

ctx.x: Yes sir. That’s why I had to join. I guess that’s what sparked me thinking about Ricky Lazar you know. I joined his band, it was a union band. I had to join the union right away. Go down and see Rocky Albertini in the back of his shoe store, and he signed me up and I had to promise him, you know, “Don’t be giving away too many of those appearances in the assemblies. I want to know about them when they ask you to play at the school, I want to be able to okay them or not.” So I had to call Rocky Albertini, yes…
I’m sorry, there’s a nice anecdote about you going to see Nat King Cole in Las Vegas?

Okay. Well my parents were, you know my father a lawyer in this town of Thunder Bay doing all kinds of law, a specialist in civil litigation but he would do a will or an accident case you know, or even a criminal, whatever was going on. My mother a lovely housewife. Both of them very musical and totally interested in show business. And to talk about that “Ed Sullivan Show” it was a lifeline because besides the teenage acts that he presented, Ed had everybody that was anybody in show business and he made stars at…
